candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All kanji and furigana match the image exactly, including 〔人名〕 and 〔大学名〕 annotations. However, English glosses (e.g., 'to set; to establish') were invented — the image contains no English translations. Line grouping by number is preserved.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Kanji/furigana fully accurate. Adds invented English glosses throughout, and additionally romanizes/translates the proper-noun annotations ('Yoshimura Kazuma (personal name)', 'Kyoto Seika University (university name)'), which is more fabricated content than the image shows.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Furigana error: 設定する transcribed as （せっている） instead of （せってい）. Replaced 〔人名〕 with '[person name]' and dropped the 〔大学名〕 annotation for 京都精華大, substituting an English translation. Also adds invented English glosses throughout.

rationale: The ground-truth image is a pure Japanese vocabulary list (kanji + furigana in parentheses, plus 〔人名〕/〔大学名〕 tags) with NO English translations, so every candidate loses hallucination points for inventing glosses. A ranks first: perfect character accuracy, faithful retention of the bracket annotations, and the least amount of fabricated extra text. B has equally perfect Japanese transcription but adds more invented material (translated/romanized proper-noun annotations), so it ranks second. C ranks last due to an actual furigana error (せっている for せってい), the dropped 〔大学名〕 annotation, and the same gloss hallucination problem as the others.
